# Suzhou Housing Flood C-end
A uni-app H5 frontend for Suzhou housing flood-prevention services, switched from demo to real-backend remote mode with passing E2E on 2026-11-03.

## Architecture and backend
- Remote mode connects to service-expand 9610 at `/v2.0/safety/flood/*` and auth service 9211
- Deployed via nginx reverse proxy at http://127.0.0.1:8095 with /api-flood to 9610 and /api-auth to 9211 to avoid browser CORS
- Login credentials user `zsbase` / password `Zs@2026Aa!` (also the AES vector); `.env` added to .gitignore to avoid committing the password

## Auth and encryption
- Login uses pure-JS AES-256-CBC; vector `Zs@2026Aa!` yields ciphertext `H03W0LoMA6EFQZIW46BnNA==`, aligned with backend AESUtil
- request.ts injects `zhi-project-id: suzhufang` and Bearer token, unwraps `{code,msg,data}` envelope

## Key implementation
- src/stores/flood.ts implements remote mode: login / fetchTemplate / searchComplex / submitInspection / submitRescue / fetchHistoryPage / countHistory / getRecordAsync; drafts stay local, demo behavior preserved
- Four pages (inspection / detail / history / rescue) rebuilt by teammate fe-pages; E2E spec by teammate e2e-dev
- 19-digit snowflake IDs must be sent as String (see snowflake_id_precision_loss)
- Fixed history to detail navigation bug where `kind` was not passed, so rescue detail wrongly called the inspection endpoint

## Verification
- On 2026-11-03: typecheck EXIT=0, unit tests 20/20 green, build:h5 success, real-backend Playwright E2E 3/3 passed (stable across two consecutive runs)

# 苏住房防汛C端
防汛巡检 C 端仓库（uni-app Vue3 H5 + 后端 Flood 服务），前端目录 D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端。

## 代码与分支
- master 无远程，首提交 8311331；整体未跟踪(??)，solo master 直开不建 worktree
- 后端分支 develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang-dev，3 子模块改动：common-flowable、service-expand、zhi2-property
- 联调文档 docs/backend-integration.md 与 docs/backend-integration.mjs

## 后端服务
- zhi2-property-server(9604)、common-framework-server(9211 鉴权)、service-expand(9610 承载 60 Flood 接口/7 Controller)
- 响应契约：JsonResult<T>={code,msg,data}(200 成功)；PageResult<T>={total,rows,code,msg,summary}
- 巡检 submit 走 flowable：SubmitInfoDto={id(必填),busCode?,deptId?,submitTittle?,procDefId?,variables?}；无配置(vo==null)报「提交流程失败，请检查审批流配置」
- 巡检 save 前置：须 bizState=FINISHED 预警事件且严格阶段匹配；save 后置 bizState=PENDING_SUBMIT
- 阶段：bizState=2 历史事件；汛中(3)/汛后(4)可填报；讯前(pre)/汛中(mid)/汛后(post)
- 完整「填报→提交」前提：dev 各阶段 FINISHED 事件 + busCode flowable 配置；用户须有 flood:inspection:add/submit 权限且为绑定小区物业部门用户（subject=property）
- 物业区域可搜"小"（如"天地华城小区" code 667577485357516）
- `/v2.0/property/patrol/item/page` 联调返 total=0（疑多数据源切换，2026-11-03 未定位）
- 达梦库 ZHISHU_PROPERTY 与 SERVICE_EXPAND 均有 T_PATROL_ITEM 表但结构不同

## 本地部署
- nginx 配置 D:\nginx\conf\conf.d\flood-c-h5.conf，root D:/repository/苏住房防汛C端/dist/build/h5，监听 8095
- 访问 http://127.0.0.1:8095/（H5 hash 路由）返200标题「苏住房防台防汛」
- 反代：/api-flood/→http://127.0.0.1:9610/；/api-auth/→http://127.0.0.1:9211/
- 曾因共用 8103 与「昆山物管」冲突，已迁 8095（2026-11-03）
- .env 配 VITE_DATA_MODE=remote 连真实后端（2026-11-03 task-2 E2E 全绿）

## 登录与鉴权
- 登录 POST /api-auth/v2.0/security/auth/login，body {username,password(AES-256 加密后 base64)}，头带 zhi-project-id: suzhufang
- 返回 {code:200,data:{accessToken}}；token 存 localStorage 键 flood-token-v1
- 账号 zsbase / Zs@2026Aa!；AES 密文 H03W0LoMA6EFQZIW46BnNA==（KEY=A-16-Byte-keyVal，IV=A-16-Byte-String，AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding）
- UI 自动登录：.env 配 VITE_LOGIN_USER/PWD，App.vue 启动自动登录
- 内部 Feign 调用须带 zhi-project-id 请求头

## 前端架构
- import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE（'demo'|'remote'）；remote 调后端映射 VO→FloodRecord
- FloodItem={templateItemId,label,fillType,fillOptions?,unit?,value,sortNo?}；FloodRecord={inspectionNo,complexName,checkDate,subject,bizState,items?,rescue?,values?}
- store API：fetchTemplate(kind)→{kind,eventId,stage,items}；searchComplex(keyword)→{code,name}[]；submitInspection(kind,values)；submitRescue(values)；saveDraft/loadDraft；fetchHistoryPage/countHistory；getRecord(id)/getRecordAsync(id,kind)
- 渲染：fillType==='1'或数值→数字输入(非负整数)；fillOptions→选择；否则文本；值绑 FloodItem.value(字符串)
- 草稿 remote 仅存本地 uni storage，提交才发后端
- 19 位雪花 ID 须 String() 传参（Number() 精度丢失致「预警不存在」），store.submitInspectionRemote 已改 String(values.eventId) 等（2026-11-03 修复）

## 页面改造（task-1，2026-11-03）
- 改动 inspection/index.vue、detail/index.vue、history/index.vue、rescue/index.vue、types/inspection.ts
- inspection：onLoad 读 kind→fetchTemplate 动态渲染；物业区域可搜索下拉(searchComplex，记 complexId=code+complexName)；submit→submitInspection，demo 回退 cardsFor
- detail：getRecord(id)→无则 getRecordAsync(id,kind)；优先渲染 record.items，rescue 渲染 record.rescue
- history：fetchHistoryPage/countHistory；字段 inspectionNo/complexName/checkDate
- rescue：物业区域可搜索下拉；字段映射 submitRescue
- 验证：typecheck✅；build:h5✅；tools/testing 20/20✅
- 提交 d3c7440（2026-11-03）：修复详情页核验项标签折行，改 theme.css .detail-row-label

## 真实后端 E2E
- task-2（2026-11-03）新增 tests/e2e/remote.spec.ts + playwright.config.ts，5 场景全绿；详见技术模式实体「苏住房防汛C端E2E测试」
